payload.entry: schema-ops landed test-only under src/native/albums/update/ (protocol.rs, ops.rs, mod.rs) gated by #[cfg(test)] in albums/mod.rs; no public command. 17 update tests pass; 197 albums+records lib tests pass; cargo fmt clean; workspace clippy gate shows 0 errors. Wire examples for schema-spans: {"schema_version":1,"expect":"sha256:…","ops":[]} no-op; {"op":"album.set","set":{"label":"Eateries"},"unset":["plural"]}; {"op":"field.add","label":"Status","kind":"choices","position":0,"choices":[{"label":"To try"},{"label":"Liked","emoji":"💚"}]}; {"op":"field.set","field":"status","set":{"required":true}}; {"op":"field.move","field":"status","position":0}; {"op":"field.remove","field":"status"}; {"op":"choice.add","field":"status","label":"Regular","emoji":"🔁","position":2}; {"op":"choice.set","field":"status","value":"regular","set":{"label":"Regular","emoji":"🔁"}} (empty emoji removes icon); {"op":"choice.move","field":"status","value":"regular","position":0}; {"op":"choice.remove","field":"status","value":"regular"}. Undo restoration: field.add accepts restore_key, choice.add accepts restore_value; each only creates an absent key, never renames; field.remove inverse is add+follow-up field.set for required/default/min/max. Interfaces for schema-spans: protocol::parse_envelope(&str)->Envelope{expect,ops}; ops::apply_ops(&[Op],&ApplyInputs)->OpOutcome{after_raw,after_type,after_plural,per_op,derived_keys,consequence,inverse_ops,group_before/after}; ops::ApplyInputs{before_raw,before_type,before_plural,stem,folder,index_refs,other_fields,today}; ops::IndexRefs{index_by,index_facets}; ops::OtherAlbumField{path,key,storage,list}.

schema-ops verified: 17 update unit tests pass (all 9 ops, ordered batches, collisions, kind-specific defaults incl. today token, unset vs false/zero/empty, used/index/storage refusals with counts, list usage, incomplete-scan guard, missing targets, position edges, inverse round-trips); 197 albums+records lib tests pass; cargo fmt clean; workspace clippy gate 0 errors. Test-only update module under #[cfg(test)], no public command, no version/changelog edits.

payload.entry: HANDOFF: schema-command consumes the test-only src/native/albums/update modules. Wire shape: parse_envelope accepts schema_version/expect/ordered ops; inverse op metadata is restore: {spans: [{key_path, expected, prior}]} with schema paths under record and exact entry bytes or null (see update/mod.rs examples). Interfaces: ops::apply_ops(&[Op], &ApplyInputs) -> OpOutcome; spans::apply_schema_ops(markdown, ops, aligned restorations, outcome, inputs) -> SchemaSpanEdit; plan::plan_update(vault, config_path, snapshot, registry, requested_stem, envelope, today) -> UpdatePlan. The plan returns one optional combined FileEdit plus read dependencies; semantic no-op returns edit=None and original album bytes without index repair. Run 28 album update unit tests with cargo test --lib native::albums::update.
